h1: WhatsApp Business API for Small Businesses in India: Pricing, Setup and Use Cases (2026)
quickAnswer: The WhatsApp Business API lets a business send automated, personalised messages at scale — booking reminders, order updates, offers and chatbot replies — from one number used by a whole team. In India, Meta charges per delivered template message: about ₹0.86 for marketing and ₹0.115 for utility messages in 2026, plus 18% GST and your provider's platform fee.

sections.heading: What is the difference between the WhatsApp Business app and the API?

blocks.text: If you reply to under 30–40 chats a day yourself, the free app is enough. Once several people handle chats, or you want reminders and follow-ups to send themselves, the API pays for itself.

Chatbots, CRM and booking integrations, triggered messages

Template messages to opted-in customers at scale

sections.heading: How much does the WhatsApp Business API cost in India in 2026?

blocks.text: Since 1 July 2025, Meta charges per delivered template message rather than per conversation (Meta pricing documentation). On 1 January 2026, India's marketing rate rose about 10%, from roughly ₹0.7846 to ₹0.8631 per message (Monty Mobile).

rows: Booking confirmation, order update, payment reminder
Your reply when a customer messages first

blocks.text: Three more costs to budget for: 18% GST on Meta's charges, your Business Solution Provider's (BSP) monthly platform fee, and any per-message markup the BSP adds. Meta has adjusted rates several times in 2026, so check the current rate card before you plan a large campaign (Baat.ai).

Cost-saving tip: a marketing message costs several times more than a utility one. Send order updates and reminders as utility templates, and keep marketing messages for offers that earn their cost. Meta reviews categories, so don't file promotions as utility.

sections.heading: What can a small business use it for?

items: Clinics and wellness: appointment confirmations, reminders a day before, follow-up and review requests
Salons: booking via chatbot, reminders, birthday offers and membership renewals
Restaurants and home foods: order updates, festive pre-order campaigns, reorder reminders
Education: enquiry follow-up, counselling slot booking, admission deadline reminders
Retail and D2C: cart recovery, delivery updates, restock alerts

blocks.text: Paired with click-to-WhatsApp ads on Instagram and Facebook, the API turns an ad click into a qualified conversation in seconds — often the fastest way to cut cost per customer.

sections.heading: How do you set up the WhatsApp Business API?

items: Choose a BSP (Business Solution Provider) or connect directly through Meta's Cloud API.
Verify your business in Meta Business Manager with your GST or registration documents.
Register a phone number that isn't active on the regular WhatsApp app (or migrate it).
Set your display name and profile — logo, description, address, website.
Create message templates for confirmations, reminders and offers, and submit them for approval.
Connect your systems — booking software, CRM, Shopify or your website forms — so messages trigger automatically.
Build opt-in into every form, ad and checkout, and track replies and conversions.

blocks.text: Most businesses go live within one to two weeks once documents are ready.

sections.heading: What about consent and India's data protection law?

blocks.text: Only message people who have opted in, and make opting out easy. India's Digital Personal Data Protection Rules were notified in November 2025, with the main consent, notice and data-rights obligations enforceable from 13 May 2027 (Consent.in). Building clear, recorded opt-in now avoids rework later and protects your number's quality rating.

faqs.question: Is the WhatsApp Business API free in India?
faqs.answer: No. Replies to customer-initiated chats are free, but template messages you send are charged per delivery, plus GST and your provider's fee.

faqs.question: Can I send bulk messages to all my contacts?
faqs.answer: Only to customers who have opted in, using approved templates. Messaging people without consent leads to blocks, a lower quality rating and limits on your number.

faqs.question: Do I get the green tick?
faqs.answer: The verified badge is granted by Meta to notable brands and isn't guaranteed. Business verification and a complete profile still build trust.

faqs.question: Can I keep using my current number?
faqs.answer: Yes, but it must be removed from the regular WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business app before it is registered on the API.

faqs.question: How is the API different from WhatsApp Channels?
faqs.answer: Channels are one-way broadcasts to followers. The API is for two-way, personalised messages to individual customers.
